SWS DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-11
DEFECTS FOUND BY INPUT SIGNAL 
CHECK
If the input signal check finds a defect, follow the 
table below to check.
Fog light
Fog lights do not illuminate when the fog 
light switch is turned on.
L-1
P.54B-154
Fog lights do not go out when the 
headlights (low-beam) are turned off while 
the fog lights are on.
L-2
P.54B-160
Dome light
The dome light does not illuminate.
M-1
P.54B-161
The dome light dimming function does not 
work normally.
M-2
P.54B-166
Theft-alarm system
Theft-alarm system is not armed (Security 
indicator light does not illuminate)
N-1
P.54B-169
The horn does not sound when the theft-
alarm system is triggered.
N-2
P.54B-176
The headlights (high-beam) do not flash 
when the theft-alarm system is triggered.
N-3
P.54B-184
The panic alarm function does not work.
N-4
P.54B-184
